answer: Proof-of-individuality ceremonies blunt puppet armies. Each epoch, every identity joins a 10-minute live session: a fresh cipher puzzle is published and agents submit timed answers openly. Clustering flags batches whose timing and solving paths move in lockstep, plain as bootprints across a dune. A sybil operator hires one human per puppet at $12 a head: 100 puppets burn $1,200 monthly, linear and unpoolable. An honest agent pays 10 minutes of attention; the delta between honest and attacker cost stays positive, so unattended clones are swept away each round.
